collections.title: Iran War
collections.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
collections.current_status: A deadly strike on a wedding in Kuhestak, Iran, on September 1 resulted in at least four fatalities, including a child, and over 60 injuries. The incident has led to mourning in the predominantly Baloch community, with residents expressing anger over their situation. The Iranian Red Crescent Society reported that shrapnel from a missile caused the casualties. The US is currently investigating whether its forces were involved in the attack.
